# Files exempt from the no-added-tabs check in workflows/nonempty-diff.yml.
# One glob per line; `#` starts a comment. A pattern without a slash matches
# the file name in any directory (`Makefile` covers `sub/Makefile`); a pattern
# with a slash matches the path from the repo root. Add a file type here only
# when the format itself requires tab indentation.
Makefile
makefile
GNUmakefile
*.mk
*.go
# Tool-written files: git and the Go tools rewrite these with tabs.
.gitmodules
.gitconfig*
go.mod
go.work
